d_ref_definition: linear 95th percentile of per-module relative_delta at final available AdamW pilot measurement
optimizer: AdamW only; Muon rejected at M2

screening_rules.selection: among eligible stable radii, lowest token-weighted training loss; exact ties choose the larger radius
screening_rules.inactive_interpretation: a radius below 1 percent post-warm-in hits does not test DeltaBall causally
screening_rules.overconstrained_interpretation: a radius above 50 percent post-warm-in matrix hits is rejected as excessive radial pressure
